observations: Board vs JLC BOM / owner BOM / CPL: all 206 CPL rows and 82 codes (81 JLC + C84) agree with the board footprints' LCSC, Manufacturer Part and footprint names; CPL side and position agree except the two deliberate JLC centroid offsets (J3 4.600 -> 4.505 mm, J430 y 24.30 -> 25.85 mm) that jlc_corrections.json records.

Schematic vs board: all 216 board footprints have a schematic symbol (222 symbols with power flags) with identical Value, LCSC, Manufacturer, Manufacturer Part and Footprint; the 130 parts carrying a second 'LCSC Part' field give the same code as 'LCSC' (no contradictory part-number field).

Value vs maker part number decoded for every line (Samsung, Murata, Yageo CC/RC/RT, FH, UNI-ROYAL including 0603WAF220KT5E = 2.2 ohm and 25121WF360LT4E = 0.36 ohm, Vishay MCT0603MD2004BP500 = 2 Mohm 0.1 % 25 ppm/K inside its 47 ohm-2 Mohm range, FOJAN FRC0603F2262TS): no value, tolerance, dielectric or voltage code disagrees with the Comment.

jlc_orient --verify-cpl on the committed board and CPL: 67 top + 125 bottom rows rebuilt from JLC footprints, worst residual 0.491 mm, errors none, 14 placement-only (C21190 rows); matches the records' 192 + 14.

Pinout spot checks against maker pin maps: BAT54A (pin 3 common anode on 3V3, pin 1 cathode on PYRO1_COLD), SRV05-4 (pin 5 VCC on 3V3, pin 2 GND), USBLC6-2SC6, D9 / D123 cathodes on RAW_PROTECTED / 3V3, LS120 + on 3V3 (MLT-5020 p4 polarity vs EasyEDA C94598 pad 1): all consistent.

Voltage ratings vs operating points: every capacitor on BAT_IN / RAW_PROTECTED / VLOGIC is 25 V or 50 V against <= 10.18 V (OVLO corner); 5 V and 3.3 V rails use >= 16 V parts; D8 SMBJ12CA VRWM 12 V > 8.4 V; ESD103 VRWM 15 V > 5.2 V at J400.2; AON7524 / AO3400A VGS 12 V and AONR21357 25 V not exceeded.
Resistor dissipation: R92 31 mW at 10.18 V, R405 28 mW, R134 pulse 35.80 W at 70 C vs the 61.2 W 20 ms chart read (records reproduce: 1.97109 ohm, 0.71595 J, 1.23x).

Recalculated records reproduce: R430 1.041-1.249 A (SLVS841 eq. 1), R405 >= 5.63 mA, GAP-3 0.490 W / 109.2-123.9 C / 112.3 C/W, loaded-pack 5.880831 V, continuity 99.369 / 99.338 / 146.23 mV, divider fault 3.342 V, C126 discharge 0.6782 ms, IWDG 28.571-32.653 ms and 34.853 ms guard, DB125 diagonal 1.2619 mm, VCAP 1.683-2.783 uF, D402 leakage 5.7 mV and 14 mV ESD step.
